_README: TEMPLATE ONLY — #2290 genesis producer set for the N5 two-node testnet cut.
This file contains NO key material. Every value below is a placeholder that the
key ceremony (docs/security/PRODUCER_KEY_CEREMONY.md) replaces with real PUBLIC
artifacts. Private keys NEVER leave the HSM/YubiKey and NEVER appear in any file.
Consumed by native-chain/src/bin/launch_api/genesis_producers.rs, either as
WRFCOIN_GENESIS_PRODUCER_SET=@/abs/path/to/this-file.json or, preferred for the
cut, pinned into the TESTNET_GENESIS_PRODUCER_SET literal in that module.
The producer set is folded into state_root. Every node MUST load the byte-identical
set or the nodes compute different state roots for the same genesis and fork at
block 1. This is one artifact copied to both nodes, never assembled per-node.
FIELD RULES (enforced at load; see the RED-first tests in genesis_producers.rs):
producer_id     stable operator identity, unique, no surrounding whitespace.
Does NOT rotate when the signing key rotates.
payout_address  canonical Address: '0x' + 40 LOWERCASE hex. Coinbase target.
NOT PublicKey::to_address() — that returns a 'wrf…' string and
is a DIFFERENT format that will be rejected. Deliberately
decoupled from public_key (§R2) so key rotation never moves
payouts.
public_key      block-signing ed25519 PUBLIC key, 64 LOWERCASE hex chars, no
'0x' prefix. Must be a valid ed25519 point. Unique per producer.
OWNER DECISION REQUIRED before the cut: the two producer_id values below are a
proposal, not a confirmed naming. Confirm them at the ceremony and record them in
the ceremony log — once genesis is minted these strings are immutable consensus
state and cannot be renamed without a fresh chain.
